svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Kale
g.desc: Happy birthday, dear. I hope you never run out of reason to smile, courage to chase your dreams, or strength to overcome difficult days. May you heart always be surrounded by warmth, kindness, and genuine happiness.

g.title: zos
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap, Huge appreciation for your endless generosity, constant sponsorship, and always going the extra mile for Arcade and the GC. May your kindness return to you in countless blessings, happiness, and success. Stay awesome and keep shining! ✨

g.title: golbahar_
g.desc: Trap happy birthday 🥹🫶🏻 i wish u thw best day and a very blessed happy year💗

g.title: KlTE
g.desc: Trap you are very sweet and kind You deserve all the happiness, love, and magic this world has to offer. Keep shining, keep smiling, and never let that beautiful spark in you fade. May your life always be filled with little moments that make your heart happy. Stay precious, birthday girl! 🎀💕✨

g.title: SHIVAAY
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap, Congratulations on getting slightly older 🥂🎂

g.title: drel
g.desc: HII HAPPY BDAYY TRAPP! HAVE A NICE DAYY! i ran out of ink😭 but still happiest bdayyy

g.title: ShYIaa
g.desc: Well I ain't a birthday paragraph typa person and honestly I don't even know you lol... but wishing you a very happy birthday hope we get to meet eo one day( maybe a lil bit 🤏🏻)

g.title: sies
g.desc: Trap 🫂🫂🫂🫂🫂🫂🫂 big and warmmm hugs for you askim!!!!! Happy birthday, I wish you allll the best 💗💗💗🥺🤍🤍🤍

g.title: eris
g.desc: Happiest Birthday Trap! I hope your cake is delicious and you have a wonderful day today!

g.desc: HBDD TRAPP!!! HAVE A GREAT DAY AND YEAR AHEAD! 🪄

g.title: ceith
g.desc: happy birthday, trap! wishing you nothing but the best🥳 enjoy your day.

g.title: Asma_
g.desc: I wish you the happiest birthday trap!! May the year ahead brings you success, lots of blessings and happiness🤍

g.title: idzy
g.desc: happy birthday! we may not know each other that well, but i hope you have a wonderful day filled with happiness, laughter, and good memories. may this new chapter of your life bring you countless blessings, new opportunities, and everything your heart wishes for. wishing you nothing but the best. enjoy your special day! 🤍
